# Alpha Product

Alpha Product solves the problem of turning declared knowledge sources into a readable, traceable product overview. It is suitable for readers and operators who need to understand the product before choosing a capability.

To start, open `Home.md`, follow the Alpha Product link, and then open the product overview or the Core module page.

This conclusion comes from `raw://alpha/product-overview.md` through source `source-overview` and claim `claim-overview`. This fixture describes Alpha Product version 1 and applies to the current sample.
